stem_book: A small ball is given some velocity at point A towards right so that it moves on the semicircular track and does not leave contact upto the highest point B. After leaving the highest point B, it falls at the top of a building of height R and width x (x << 2R). (All the surfaces are frictionless). The horizontal distance of the ball from the foot of building where the ball strikes the horizontal ground is (a) √2 R (b) (1 + √2)R (c) 2(1 + √2)R (d) 12R
work: rebound v_x = v_y = √(2gR) from height R: t = (√(2gR) + √(4gR))/g ⇒ x = v_x t = (2 + 2√2)R = 2(1 + √2)R
